title: The panel's Brief section is collapsed by default and opens on a click
name: brief-toggle
description: In apps/dashboard/src/panel/Panel.tsx the Brief `<Section>` (approach, acceptance list, approval line) renders open whenever `node.brief !== null`, and on a node with a long approach it pushes the dependency list and the decisions off the screen. Make it a disclosure: closed by default, one click on the heading opens it. Use a native `<details>`/`<summary>` around the existing content — no state library, no new component — with the summary styled like the other Section headings so the panel stays one rhythm. The approval line (`not approved yet` / `approved by …`) stays visible in the closed state next to the heading, so a person still sees at a glance whether the node can run without opening the brief. Every other Section keeps its current behaviour. Extend apps/dashboard/src/panel/Panel.test.tsx: the brief's approach text is not in the document (or the details is closed) on first render, and is after a click on the summary; the approval line is visible in both states.

brief.approach:
One component, one test file. 1. `apps/dashboard/src/panel/Panel.tsx`, the `node.brief !== null` block (~line 99): replace `
` with a native `
` — no `useState`, no new component. The `` holds the same heading styling `Section` uses (`font-medium text-[length:var(--text-xs)] text-[var(--ink-faint)] uppercase tracking-wider`, plus `cursor-pointer select-none`) and, on the same line, the approval text that today sits at the bottom (`not approved yet` / `approved by … , queued`) in `normal-case` faint ink — so a closed brief still says whether the node can run. Inside the details: the `` approach and the acceptance `
    ` exactly as they are; delete the trailing approval `

    ` since it moved up. No `open` attribute, so it renders closed on every node; the browser keeps it open across re-renders while the same panel is mounted. Every other `Section` is untouched. 2. `apps/dashboard/src/panel/Panel.test.tsx`: extend the existing "the approach renders as what was written" test or add one beside it — jsdom keeps `

    ` children in the DOM whether open or not, so assert on the element: `container.querySelector('details')` exists and has no `open` attribute on first render; the summary's text contains `not approved yet`; after `fireEvent.click` on the summary, the `details` has `open`. Keep the existing markdown assertions (heading `How`, `li` count, no `## How`) passing — they read the DOM, not visibility. Nothing else: no theme tokens, no `panel/data.ts` change, no localStorage.

acceptance.proves: The brief is a native disclosure, not a state-driven component
The approval line was moved into the summary, not duplicated
Closed on first render, open after a click on the summary, approval text visible while closed, markdown assertions still hold
